scripts.title: Reinstall ESET (Security Product, Inspect Connector, Agent)
scripts.summary: Removes the ESET security product, Inspect Connector and Management Agent in a safe order, then reinstalls everything with an ESET PROTECT installer.
details: The security product is removed first. If that fails, nothing else is touched, so the device stays protected and managed. Without any ESET software installed, the script installs directly.
Each product is tried without a password first, then with every supplied password. Passwords can come from the -UninstallPassword parameter or from a NinjaOne custom field, and are masked in the log.
Handles a busy Windows Installer (1618), stale MSI transform references (1624) and repository download errors (5003/5009) with retries.
Downloads the installer into a private folder that only SYSTEM and Administrators can access, and only runs it with a valid ESET Authenticode signature.
Every run removes and reinstalls ESET, so run it once per device and do not schedule it as a recurring task.

parameters.name: -Url
parameters.description: ESET PROTECT installer URL (https://redirector.eset.systems/li-handler/?uuid=...). Required. Use an installer that contains ESET Server Security for Windows Server.

parameters.name: -LogPath
parameters.description: Folder for the MSI uninstall logs. Default: logs are deleted after use. When set, logs are masked in the private working folder and only then copied there; a new folder is created with access for SYSTEM and Administrators only.

parameters.name: -PasswordFieldName
parameters.description: NinjaOne custom field with more passwords, one per line or separated by "|". Default: esetUninstallPassword.

parameters.name: -ScheduleReboot
parameters.description: Schedule a reboot after -RebootDelaySec seconds if one is required. Default: $false.

exitCodes.meaning: Success. Check the log for "REBOOT REQUIRED".
Installer signature invalid or not signed by ESET
